title: Composing
brief:
Two new building blocks:

  • turn(direction) — face a direction. Pass one of UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT.
  • move_forward() — take one step in whatever direction you're facing.

Write a parameterized helper def go(direction, n): that turns and then walks n steps. That one helper replaces all four of walk_right_seven, walk_left_seven, etc.

Then build a second helper that uses go — that's composition. The repeated down in this snake-path begs for it.
solution:
def go(direction, n):
    turn(direction)
    for i in range(n):
        move_forward()

def descend():
    go(DOWN, 2)

go(RIGHT, 7)
descend()
go(LEFT, 7)
descend()
go(RIGHT, 6)
open_chest()
